name: Aerodynamics of Flight
description: Principles of subsonic aircraft aerodynamics, performance, stability, and control, covering both fixed- and rotary-wing configurations. Topics include standard atmosphere, pressure, temperature, and density altitudes; aerodynamics fundamentals: airfoils, wings, lift, drag, moments; incompressible flow over airfoils: vortex sheet, Kutta condition, thin airfoil theory; finite wings: downwash, induced drag, lifting-line theory; subsonic compressible flow: compressibility effects, critical and drag-divergence mach numbers, supercritical airfoils; airplane performance: thrust, power, efficiency, level flight, climb, ceilings; stability and control: static/dynamic stability, trim, control surfaces; rotary-wing basics: blade element and momentum theory, induced velocity, and rotor control.
